requirements.title: Suitable generic interfaces match direction/form and dtv argument compatibility
requirements.definition: A suitable generic interface for defined input/output has a defined-io-generic-spec appropriate to the read/write direction and formatted/unformatted form of the data transfer, and has a specific interface whose dtv argument is compatible with the effective item according to argument association rules.

pending.suitable-interface-matches-direction-and: Provide separate READ(FORMATTED) and WRITE(FORMATTED) specifics with distinctive sentinels and assert the parent transfer direction/form selects only the matching generic spec.
pending.suitable-interface-dtv-compatible-with-e: Use effective items whose dynamic or declared type compatibility differs by one property and assert only compatible dtv specifics are callable, with incompatible controls reserved for clause 15 diagnostics.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or using a compile-only conforming control) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT or named status values where the standard names them, required dummy characteristics through a conforming interface, or required diagnosis of a numbered syntax rule or constraint. Negative plans change one source property from a conforming control and do not require a particular diagnostic message, severity, exit status, printed rule number, IOMSG wording, or processor-dependent numeric status value.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, and existing clause 12/13 catalogues for source form, derived types, generic bindings, expressions, variables, execution constructs, data-transfer statement forms, control information, file positioning, and edit descriptors. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: later 12.6 effective-item and data-transfer termination rules; 12.7-12.11 connection, transfer, status, and error semantics; clause 15 interface, generic, type-bound, and argument association rules; clause 16 ISO_FORTRAN_ENV named constants; clause 19 scope and lifetime controls where active parent data transfer statements are reached.

requirements.title: Defined I/O occurs when permitted circumstances and a suitable procedure are both present
requirements.definition: When a derived-type effective item is encountered during data transfer, defined input/output occurs if the circumstances permit defined input/output and a suitable defined input/output procedure is available.

pending.defined-io-occurs-with-permitted-circums: Use a suitable WRITE(FORMATTED) DTIO procedure that assigns module integer `selected=10`. Initialize `selected=-9`, execute a parent internal WRITE whose edit descriptor for the derived effective item is DT, and assert `selected` is 10 after the transfer.
pending.defined-io-occurs-with-suitable-procedur: Use a permitted DT parent transfer and a suitable DTIO procedure that assigns module integer `selected=20`. Initialize `selected=-9`, execute the transfer, and assert `selected` is 20, showing the available suitable procedure is used.
pending.list-directed-namelist-unformatted-circu: Provide suitable list-directed, namelist, and unformatted DTIO specifics that assign distinct module values such as 31, 32, and 33 before child transfer; execute each parent form with `selected=-9` and assert the matching value.
pending.dt-edit-descriptor-circumstance-permits-: Provide a suitable formatted DTIO specific that assigns `selected=40`; execute an internal WRITE with a DT edit descriptor for the effective item and assert `selected` changed from -9 to 40.
pending.type-bound-procedure-can-be-suitable: Define a suitable generic type-bound DTIO procedure that assigns `selected=50`; execute a matching parent transfer with `selected=-9` and assert 50.
pending.accessible-interface-can-be-suitable: Define a suitable generic interface-block DTIO procedure that assigns `selected=60`; execute a matching parent transfer for a type with no suitable type-bound binding and assert 60.

requirements.title: Type-bound defined I/O resolution selects the dynamic-type corresponding binding
requirements.definition: If a suitable generic type-bound procedure is available from the declared type, the procedure reference is determined as for explicit type-bound procedure references: the binding with the appropriate specific interface is located in the declared type and the corresponding binding in the dynamic type is selected.

pending.type-bound-defined-io-locates-declared-t: Make both a suitable type-bound DTIO binding and a suitable accessible generic interface-block DTIO for the same declared type. Initialize module `selected=-9`; have the type-bound specific assign 51 and the interface specific assign 61. A matching parent transfer must leave `selected=51`, showing that the declared-type binding is the one located when 2a is true.
pending.type-bound-defined-io-selects-dynamic-ty: Use a polymorphic effective item declared as a parent type whose dynamic extension overrides the defined I/O binding. Parent and extension specifics assign distinct sentinels such as 71 and 72; after a matching parent transfer assert the dynamic extension sentinel 72.

requirements.title: Accessible interface-block defined I/O resolves to the identified specific procedure
requirements.definition: If no suitable generic type-bound procedure is available and a suitable generic interface is accessible, the reference is to the procedure identified by the appropriate specific interface in the interface block.

pending.interface-block-defined-io-selects-appro: Use a type with no suitable type-bound DTIO binding and an accessible generic interface block containing formatted and unformatted specifics that assign distinct module values such as 81 and 82. Execute matching parent transfers from `selected=-9` and assert the appropriate interface-block specific value is recorded.

accounting.rationale: Defines suitability of a generic interface.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.4.8, defined input/output (batch163). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Round 1 found obligations filed as definitions - the 12.6.4.8.4 resolution rules, and the 12.6.4.8.3 effects that a child data transfer inherits the parent's connection modes, does not position the file, ignores ADVANCE=, associates dtv with the effective item and starts where the file was positioned; all are now requirements with plans in which a DTIO procedure records its observations in module variables with distinguished values. R1221, C1236 and C1237 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
